latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Editor Maker.

- Instantly edit and export videos (MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM, up to 500MB) via simple chat instructions.
- No need for paid software or editing skills—just upload, describe the edit (e.g., "trim pauses, add transitions"), and download a 1080p final cut.
- Automatic backend session handling and free token generation for quick start; 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports timeline summaries, session state tracking, and fast cloud rendering on GPU nodes.
- Full error handling and helpful feedback for uploads, exports, credit status, and common issues.
